scope: Read-only independent audit of stored v7 JSON; no benchmark reruns.

word_decode.interpretation: Decode timing improvement only; packet format/bytes are not changed by decoder implementation.

word_scheduler.interpretation: Diagnostic steady IDs/s is a labeled model metric; it is not strict end-to-end FPS qualification.

dirty_tile.interpretation: Dirty tile output is charged with per-tile metadata; compare packet-byte means and quality separately. Immediate-ACK experiment is not transport throughput or end-to-end FPS.
